source_caption:
He Was Technically Gay When He Punched Him.

21 Jump Street (2012) proved to be a total masterclass in subverting classic high school stereotypes. Directors Phil Lord and Christopher Miller flipped the script on 80s action-comedy tropes, dropping Jenko and Schmidt into a modern high school where being considerate, ecologically conscious, and open-minded are the new cool leaving Jonah Hill and Channing Tatum utterly confused.

source_details.title: 21 Jump Street
source_details.synopsis: 21 Jump Street is a 2012 American buddy cop action comedy film directed by Phil Lord and Christopher Miller in their live-action directorial debuts and written by Michael Bacall, based on a story by Bacall and Jonah Hill. It is the first film in the Jump Street franchise and stars Hill and Channing Tatum in the lead roles, alongside Brie Larson, Dave Franco, Rob Riggle, and Ice Cube. It is an adaptation of the 1987–1991 television series of the same name by Stephen J. Cannell and Patrick Hasburgh.
